subject: Taxes
title: Personalized Letters That Work
description: A quick, practical guide to Personalized Letters That Work.

hook.text: The UK's Behavioural Insights Team tested one change in tax letters: adding 'Most people in your area pay on time.

buildup.text: Standard tax letters use formal threats. The nudge team tested seven different messages on 100,000 delinquent taxpayers.

discovery.text: The social norm message outperformed all threat-based messages.

twist.text: Adding a photo of the person's street increased response rates further.

climax.text: A sentence swap in a letter collected £210 million more than threats. The nudge cost almost nothing.

punchline.text: One sentence, £210 million more. Nudges beat threats every time.

quiz.question: What change in UK tax letters raised £210 million in extra revenue?
options: Adding 'Most people in your area pay on time'
